_story_card: story_card.gd: the card that stands beside a watched story's person or town once the camera lands (CK3's event toast), and stays while the camera is there: width points wide; it waits wait_land seconds for the camera to land, else it isn't shown; person_radius and town_radius (world units) keep it clear of what it stands by; waits and news are its line when the story waits on the King at court, or doesn't. Closed, a story still going on leaves its mark over its place, which opens it again.
_loading: intro.gd _is_ready: once the realm stands, the loading card stays until every frame has kept steady_fps for steady_s seconds (so play starts smooth), or most_s seconds have passed since it stood.
_smooth_scale: main.gd apply_graphics: Smooth draws the 3D world at this share of the window's pixels a side (0.47: about half the pixels of the project's 0.67), MetalFX upscaling it to full size; the interface is always drawn sharp. Beautiful keeps project.godot scaling_3d/scale.
_: The interface's finesse pass (docs/review/ui-pass.md; ui.gd reads it through data.gd). The camera pad shows only when the player picks 'always' in Settings (else the camera moves by mouse, trackpad and keys) and the minimap sits flush to the right edge; the date card is capped at top.maxWidth points, its long lines ending in an ellipsis; the chronicle drawer is chronicle.width points wide and at most chronicle.height of the screen tall; a town card not pinned by its town stands on the left, townCard.width points wide; a toast is toast.width points wide.

plane._: The control plane along the screen's foot (control_plane.gd; Warcraft III's console, Age of Empires IV's bottom bar): edge (px from the screen's sides and foot), gap (between its slots), realm_width (the date and treasury slot), date_size, goal_size (the date and the goal, px), figure_size, figure_icon, figure_word (the treasury, seals, peace, souls, tithe: always shown, never unfolding on hover), key_size, key_icon (the command card's keys, the hotkey in each corner), select_width (the selected host's slot: one width, so the strip never jumps; the strip is centred and as wide as its slots), key_columns (the realm's keys, a grid), top (where the houses table and the chronicle start), cards_top (the centre cards), toast_top (the notices).

chronicle.empty: Nothing waits on you. The whole story is in the book of the reign.
chronicle._: chronicle_panel.gd: the drawer down the right holds only what asks something of the King, a card each with its buttons (Mac: 'the chronicle should only be things that need to be taken action on; the book of the realm is there for the other stuff'). height a share of the screen (its width is the toolbar's); rows: the most cards kept; needs_seasons: a card unanswered this many seasons goes; empty: said when nothing waits; here: over the card the camera went to; body_lines: a card's text at most; kinds: the word for each kind on a card.

houses_strip._: The great houses at a glance, top-left (houses_strip.gd): size and sigil (px), rise (the percent of power over the year that shows an arrow), words (the stances not told by favour), tips.line (the tooltip), head (the strip's first word: the chips run strongest first), camps (the group headings while the crown is at war: with you, waiting, against you; words ally, foe, waits are each chip's word then).
houses_strip.head: By power

tips.line:
House {name}: {stance}, favour {favour} of 100
Power {power} of 100 (men, land, people, crowns and grain, against the strongest house), {trend} over the year
Click for the house

war_banner._: The crown's wars in the control plane, one line each under the goal (top_bar.gd _show_wars; bridge /world kingWars, warUpkeep): line ({foe} {taken} {towns} {way} {score}), the way words by its standing (bridge peace.js standing.way: the war score against peace.json terms.gold; score: −100..+100, towns, the seat and battles), cost (each war's share of the season's upkeep), tip.
war_banner.line: War on {foe} · {taken} of {towns} towns taken · {way}, war score {score}
war_banner.tip: Click for the house you are at war with

war_moment._: A war declared (ui.gd _war_moment; WAR.md step 7): the line told with the sides as they fell ({foe}, {houses}), alone when no house rides with the crown; edge (0..1) how far the screen's edge goes to war, fading over seconds.

war_council._: The war council before a war is declared (war_council.gd; bridge war.js council): its words ({foe} {odds} {ours} {theirs} {price} {upkeep} {from} {to} {at} {towns} filled in), width (px), title_size (px).
war_council.title: War on {foe}
war_council.cost: {price} now, then {upkeep} a season while it runs
war_council.alarm: The realm's alarm rises {from} to {to} of {at}; at {at} the houses league against you
war_council.goal: To win, take their {towns} towns one by one, the seat last. Lose, and they ask a town of you.

reckoning._: What a choice changed, over the control plane (reckoning.gd; rows from bridge reckoning.js): head (its title after a choice), came (its title when an order comes back, aftermath.js, with the line), width (px, the line's), size (px), most (rows shown), step (seconds between rows landing), hold (seconds shown), linger (seconds after the mouse leaves).
reckoning.head: What it changed

promises._: The King's three promises as checkboxes under the goal (top_bar.gd _show_promises): size and icon (px), do (where a click on an open promise goes, by ambition key: houses opens the great houses, town goes to its town, ledger opens the ledger), tips (the tooltip by state and by where it goes), left (the seasons before an open promise breaks). A click on an open promise opens its orders (bridge reign.js promiseActs) when it has any.

tips.open: A promise not yet kept. Keep it and every great house warms to you; break it, by its time or the realm, and every one trusts your word the less.
tips.kept: Kept. The great houses took note.
tips.lost: Broken: it can no longer be kept.
tips.houses: Click: the great houses, where it is kept.
tips.town: Click: go to Kingsmere and hold it.
tips.ledger: Click: the ledger, the realm's growth over time.

politics_icons._: houses_panel.gd politics: one icon a deed in the houses table and the house card, its words and price in the tooltip (Mac: just use icons here).

next._: top_bar.gd: the next line (bridge next.js) stays quiet for these kinds: the ladder's step is the objective's own line, the court's sitting is its badge (Mac: 'I should know what the hell to do'; one thing to do at a time).

close._: ui.gd close_x: the one close X on a card (town, house, court; CK3's and Total War's panel close): its square box's size, its inset from the card's top and right edges (the same both ways; Mac: 'this is not centered'), the X's width (centred in the box), and the least corner radius of its hover box, which is otherwise the card's own less the inset (concentric with the card's corner).

counsel._: top_bar.gd _show_next: the counsel (bridge next.js) is a notice that comes and goes, not a line on the date card (Mac: the top-left stacked six things). A new word is told at most every gap seconds; the same word is told again after again seconds while it still stands.

tips.host: Selects your host and shows it to you.
tips.nowhere: Nowhere to go yet: it shows when the moment comes.

step._: top_bar.gd: the one step he is on, as a button under the goal (Anno 1800's quest tracker). do: what each objective's step buttons do, in order (host: select his host; place: go to the objective's town); a step not named goes to the place. go: the button for an objective with a place and no steps. tips: the button's tooltip, by what it does.

act._: top_bar.gd _tell_act: the reign's story's act is told as a notice when it begins (not kept on the date card), with the King's next promise still to keep.

moment._: moment_banner.gd (Total War's battle result): the word across the screen for a battle of the King's, by its losses (heroic: the foe lost heroic_ratio times the crown's; pyrrhic: the crown lost more), at: how far down the window (0 top), hold: seconds before it fades.

reign_track._: reign_track.gd (Frostpunk's countdown): the reign's four acts under the houses' strip; below: px under the strip's top, width: its width.

reign_cards._: reign_cards.gd _act_card (The Banner Saga's chapter titles): each act's name, the painting it shows (assets/intro/art; the last act shows the threatening house's own) and its question when no aim stands; act_hold: seconds before the realm plays on unclicked.

acts.name: The Testing
acts.asks: The houses have taken your measure. Now they test it.

acts.name: The Reckoning
acts.asks: What you have sown comes due.

scale._: min/max: the content scale never smaller or larger than this, however the window; default: the interface size a new player starts at and Cmd0 returns to (Settings > Interface size on top), Mac 2026-11-16 chose 70%
